sourceNotes.note: Reported updated significant lower leg injury for Drake Maye, possible season-ending.
Originating sources report on Maye significant lower leg injury that could end the season.

items.text: Drake Maye (ankle) is believed to have sustained a “significant lower leg injury” that will keep him out for an “extended period of time,” and it's possible it could end his season. Via @RapSheet
items.newStatus: Significant lower leg injury, possible rest of season
items.why: Updated report from Rapoport via RotoWire: significant lower leg injury that could end the 2026 season.
items.implication: NE offense severely impacted long-term; waiver target Corey Kiner and other NE RBs may see role changes or increased opportunity with backup QB.
items.opportunity: Monitor Corey Kiner for elevated usage; consider waiver claim if Maye absence is confirmed extended or season-ending.
corroboration: Ian Rapoport (@RapSheet): Sources: #Patriots QB Drake Maye is believed to have suffered a significant lower leg injury that will keep him out an extended period of time. It’s even possible that Maye will miss the rest of the season. Maye came back from Germany and will seek more medical information.
